title: Metric
description: A named, derivable indicator with a stable URI, a prose definition, a value type, a unit, declared dimensions, declared observation-level attributes, declared external alignments, and a single primary computation. A Metric is the catalogue definition; values reported against it are MetricObservation records. The per-record analog is ScoringRule (schema/misc.yaml), which captures the rule applied to a single subject; MetricCalculation aggregates the same shape across many subjects.

description.description: A free-text summary describing the event, situation, or record.

value_type.description: The kind of numeric or categorical value a metric carries (count, proportion, ratio, currency amount, index, duration, nominal, ordinal, qualitative).

unit.description: The unit of measure for a metric. May be a UCUM unit code, an ISO 4217 currency code for currency amounts, the SDMX UNIT_MEASURE code 'PT' for percentages, or the literal 'unitless' for proportions expressed in 0..1.

multiplier.description: SDMX-style scale exponent. 0 for units, 3 for thousands, 6 for millions, 9 for billions. Default 0.

decimals.description: The number of decimal places to use when reporting the metric.

items.description: The ordered list of MetricDimension references that disaggregate this metric. Ordering drives the DSD round-trip and the column order on SDMX-CSV emission.
The list of MetricAttribute references that may decorate observations, series, or the dataset for this metric.

calculation.description: The single primary computation that turns PublicSchema record-level data into a value for this metric. Variant computations are carried by libraries.

topic.description: The substantive topic family of the metric (coverage, adequacy, expenditure, leakage, targeting, inclusion error, exclusion error, regularity, processing time, satisfaction). Drives browsing and faceting on the website.

concept_uri.description: The skos:Concept URI this metric, dimension, or attribute realises. Multiple metrics may share a single concept_uri when they measure the same underlying notion through different operationalisations.

metric_family.description: Optional URI tagging this metric with a metric-family group. Metrics sharing a family value also share dimensions and observation-level attributes; the family value drives DSD generation. Modelled as a tag rather than a separate MetricFamily class until there are at least three real families. Named metric_family to avoid collision with the family slot in schema/civil_status.yaml.

items.description: External URIs to which this metric, dimension, or attribute aligns: SDMX agency DSDs, UN SDG indicators, ASPIRE families, ESSPROS reference metadata, SOCX DSDs, DHIS2 indicator UIDs, IATI indicator codes, HXL hashtags. Alignment is one-way semantic; PublicSchema does not synchronise with these registries.

core.description: True if the metric belongs to the core tier (shipped with every PublicSchema deployment), false if it belongs to the extended tier (opt-in, country or program-specific). Per design-principles.md principle 9.

version.description: The version identifier of an artefact such as an instrument, software agent, scoring rule, or privacy notice (for example, a release date such as 2022-10-11 or a semantic version like 6.2).

replaces.description: URI of the metric record that this metric supersedes.

replaced_by.description: URI of the metric record that supersedes this metric.
